text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu claims victory with a 
masterclass performance. Watching her, 
Symboli Rudolf feels her own passion to 
race surge within.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf announced her entry into 
the Japan Cup. The dream match featuring 
three superstars, including Mr. C.B., sent 
the public into a frenzy of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pushing herself to the limit for the Japan 
Cup, Mejiro Ramonu aims for a perfect 
victory in peak condition.
